column1: # vendor_pair_registry.tsv -- every pair of hand-maintained copies of the same
# code that live in two places, and what the drift gate does about each.
# WHY A REGISTRY AND NOT A HARDCODED PAIR.
# The gate this feeds was built for one pair (the ingest ticks). Archie found a
# second within the hour (ostler_fda), and neither of us believes that is the
# complete set. A gate that watches one of three pairs is WORSE than no gate,
# because it licenses the belief that the other two are checked. So the pairs
# are declared here, the gate enumerates THIS FILE, and it prints the
# denominator on every run.
# Add a row the moment a second copy of anything is created. A pair that is not
# declared is not checked, and the gate cannot know it exists.
# STATUS
#   enforced      the gate FAILS on drift, and FAILS if it cannot resolve either
#                 side. An enforced pair it cannot see must never pass.
#   unreconciled  a known pair whose correct direction nobody has measured yet.
#                 REPORTED loudly and counted, never silently dropped, but does
#                 not fail the cut. Promote to enforced once the direction is
#                 established and an invariant set exists.
# KIND
#   invariant_survival   every row in the named manifest must be present on BOTH
#                        sides. NOT byte equality: the tick copies legitimately
#                        differ (222 lines sealed vs 268 vendored, different
#                        headers, no SOURCE_DIR placeholder in the seal), and a
#                        diff that is red on a correct tree is not a gate, it is
#                        a nuisance that trains people to switch it off. That is
#                        precisely how "VERBATIM copy, do not diverge" ended up
#                        being enforced by a comment.
#   size_report          record the byte delta only. For unreconciled pairs, so
#                        the drift is visible and dated without asserting which
#                        side is right.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated)
#   pair_id  status  kind  manifest  side_a_label  side_a_glob  side_b_label  side_b_glob  why
# side_*_glob is resolved relative to the CM051 repo root unless it begins with
# $OSTLER_APP_PATH or $HR015_ROOT, which are resolved from the environment. A
# glob that matches nothing is an unresolved side.
pair_id
ingest_ticks
